request: Analyze GSE174785 for PMID 34358431 (Exercise-induced angiogenesis is dependent on metabolically primed ATF3/4(+) endothelial cells.): how exercise affects gene expression as the paper intends.

other_accessions_in_paper.GSE158984: scRNA-seq of muscle ECs, including sedentary vs 14-day voluntary wheel running (S2.5.p1, KRT/TAB1 line 177); not the accession assigned here

final.assay: bulk RNA-seq (Smart-seq2 / TruSeq per GEO), kallisto quantification, FACS-sorted muscle endothelial cells (S4.4.3.p1)
final.samples: 20 samples: RmECs (soleus, oxidative) and WmECs (EDL, glycolytic) from WT and Atf4 EC-knockout (Atf4^dEC/dEC) mice, n=5 per group (GEO titles; S2.6.p1, Fig6B-D)
final.exercise_factor_in_this_accession: none: all bulk samples are sedentary/unperturbed mice; exercise (14-day wheel running) appears only in histology, EdU/flow, and the scRNA-seq of GSE158984 (S2.5.p1, Fig5, Fig6E-I)
final.primary_estimand: Baseline transcriptional difference between oxidative (RmEC) and glycolytic (WmEC) capillary ECs, and its dependence on Atf4 (S2.2.p2, S2.6.p1). Not an exercise effect.
planned_contrasts: WT RmEC vs WT WmEC (S2.2.p2, Fig2G, S2.6.p1; paper: 782 DEGs)
Atf4-KO RmEC vs Atf4-KO WmEC (S2.6.p1, Fig6B; paper: 211 remaining of WT DEGs)

paper_threshold.source_locator: S2.6.p1; Fig6C legend; S4.4.3.p2 ('log fold change > 1 and adjusted p-value < 0.05')

final.paper_method: DESeq2 on kallisto counts, genes with <=1 count across all samples removed (S4.4.3.p1)

paper_reconstruction.reasoning: The paper's exercise question (wheel running, S2.5.p1) is answered with histology, EdU, flow cytometry and scRNA-seq (GSE158984). The bulk RNA-seq deposited as GSE174785 (DA.p1, TAB1 line 178: 'RNA-seq raw data for RmECs versus WmECs, WT and Atf4 dEC/dEC') compares muscle-EC subtypes and genotypes in non-exercised mice.

checks: DA.p1 and key resources table name GSE174785 as the bulk RNA-seq of RmECs vs WmECs, WT and Atf4 dEC/dEC
20 GSM samples = 2 muscles x 2 genotypes x 5 reps, matching Fig6D design

ownership.reasoning: Paper data-availability statement and GEO metadata agree.

alignment.reasoning: Merged-tar columns are GSM ids that equal the metadata index exactly (inspect: 20/20). Muscle (source_name_ch1) and genotype define the groups.

final.feature_level: transcript (ENSMUST), kallisto est_counts column per sample (sums 8.5e6-1.6e7, not TPM which sums to 1e6)

matrix.reasoning: Per-sample kallisto abundance files have est_counts and tpm; the merged matrix holds est_counts (column sum of GSM5328123 = 1.411e7 equals its est_counts sum). Fractional estimated counts at transcript level; a gene-level summary would be needed before DESeq2.

available_factors: muscle EC subtype R vs W

design.stop_reason: No exercise arm in GSE174785: all 20 samples are sedentary WT or Atf4-EC-KO mice split by muscle (soleus vs EDL). The only identifiable contrasts are muscle EC subtype and genotype, which are not exercise effects; the paper's exercise transcriptomics is scRNA-seq in GSE158984.

candidates.value: WT RmEC vs WT WmEC as exercise proxy
candidates.reason_rejected: baseline oxidative vs glycolytic EC difference in unexercised mice; the paper uses it as priming, not as an exercise response (S2.2.p2)
genetic perturbation without exercise; no exercise factor in any sample

design.reasoning: GEO characteristics carry only cell type, strain, genotype and muscle; treatment_protocol describes tamoxifen only. Paper S2.5.p1 and Fig6E-I put exercise in histology/EdU, not in this bulk RNA-seq.

discrepancies.paper: exercise studied by histology, EdU, flow and scRNA-seq (GSE158984)

discrepancies.data: GEO extract_protocol says Illumina TruSeq stranded mRNA
